reviewAlt: Illustrated artifact review with the goal, proposed file changes, a Given/When/Then case, and verification status. Keyboard controls offer approval, editing, discussion, and a revision prompt.
purposeDecision: Then it waits for you. Approve the work, edit the artifact, discuss it with the agent, or ask for another attempt. The goal is simple: useful automation with deliberate human decisions.
workflowAlt: Illustrated miau workflow: the plan from Claude is waiting for human review, while critique, implementation, and review remain ready. Approve, edit, and discuss controls appear below.
inspectionBody: Review the goal, proposed changes, risks, and verification. Cycle through the review, the full artifact, and your project’s live Git changes, right in the terminal.
purposeBody: miau gives your coding agents an orderly workflow. It assembles prompts, runs one external CLI at a time, and saves the results as files you can actually read.
seoDescription: miau is a human-gated terminal orchestrator for Claude Code and Codex. Plan, critique, implement, and review. You make the decisions.
installBody: You’ll need Rust and at least one installed, authenticated agent CLI: Claude Code or Codex. miau runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
filesBody: Plans and reports live on disk. Later agents receive artifact paths so they can read the relevant work.
changeBody: Read the contributor guide. Add a focused test, make it pass, run the checks, and open a pull request.
purposeAside: Civilisation has tried leaving things entirely to the machines. The printer is still a suspect.
workflowNote: Every step stops for your decision. The next agent does not get to wave itself through.
revisionsBody: New attempts write numbered artifacts. Earlier outputs stay put, however embarrassing.
pauseBody: Edit in your editor, discuss in the agent CLI, then return to make the next decision.
socialDescription: A small terminal orchestrator for coding agents and the humans nominally in charge.
ideaBody: Explain the problem and the smallest useful improvement. Grand manifestos optional.
bugBody: Tell us what happened, what you expected, and how to summon it again.

workflowTitle: Four steps. You hold the keys.
contributionWizard: You needn’t be a Rust wizard.

steps.name: Plan
steps.text: Decide what ought to happen before anything has the opportunity to happen.

steps.name: Critique
steps.text: Invite a second opinion. Preferably before the first opinion becomes several hundred lines of code.

steps.name: Implement
steps.text: Turn the agreed plan into working changes. One agent, one task, a reassuring lack of stampede.

steps.name: Review
steps.text: Inspect the result. Check the evidence. Decide whether the universe is marginally better off.
